info.title: Mediflow API
info.description: Generated from the API route schemas by `pnpm gen:api`. Do not edit by hand.

mfaEnabled.description: Whether sign-in asks for an authenticator code.

activeTenant.description: Null until a user with several hospitals picks one.

policy.description: Null when there is no active tenant.

needsPassword.description: False when this person already has an account: they only accept.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into an authenticator by hand.

recoveryCodes.description: One-time codes. Returned this once and never again.

primary.description: Brand colour as six-digit hex. Must read as text on a white background (contrast of at least 4.5:1); the web app falls back to its default colour otherwise.

logoUrl.description: https or same-origin URL of the hospital logo (SVG or WebP, at most 50 kB).

features.description: Module flags. A module that is absent is off.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: A session with no activity for this long ends. The web app warns shortly before and signs the user out. Absent means the app default.

status.description: A suspended hospital keeps its data but its staff cannot use the app. Tenant-scoped routes answer 403 tenant_suspended.

Invite.description: An invitation that has been emailed. The link is not returned.

PatientSummary.description: A patient as shown in a list: compact, no clinical data.

phone.description: Masked to its last four digits for a caller without patient.contact:read.

PatientPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

PatientRecord.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

phone.description: Masked to its last four digits for a caller without patient.contact:read.

version.description: Goes up by one each time the record changes. Send it back as expectedVersion when changing the record.

PatientUpdate.description: The version the change is based on, and the fields to change. Null clears an optional field. The MRN never changes.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the record the change was made from. If the record has changed since, the request is refused with 409 conflict and nothing is changed.

PatientDuplicateMatch.description: A possible duplicate, masked by the server: enough to recognise the person, not to read their details. No id.

NoticePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

userAgent.description: The browser as it described itself at sign-in, for the person to recognise the device.

current.description: True for the session making this call.

Department.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

DepartmentPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

get.description: The active hospital of the session and its configuration. Private per session, never CDN-cached.

post.description: Signs in with email and password and starts a session, returned as an httpOnly cookie. Every failure of the email and password has the same answer, 401 invalid_credentials. An account with an authenticator answers 401 mfa_required until the request also carries `code`, and 401 invalid_mfa_code when the code is wrong.

code.description: Authenticator code, or a recovery code. Only for accounts that have one.

post.description: Ends the session, on the server and in the browser. Succeeds whether or not there was one.

get.description: Bootstraps the app in one request: the signed-in user, the active tenant with its config, and the effective access policy. Private per session, never CDN-cached. Session routes ignore X-Tenant-ID, so a stale tab can always reload its session.

post.description: Rebinds the session to another hospital the user belongs to and returns the new session. Affects every tab.
What the invite screen shows before the person accepts: which hospital, which email, and whether a password has to be chosen. The token is in the body, not the URL, so it is not logged.
Accepts an invite. Someone new sets their password here (400 password_required without one). Someone with an account needs only the token. The link works once. The person then signs in.
Emails a reset link if the address has an account. The answer is the same either way, so it cannot be used to find accounts.

204.description: Done, whether or not an email is sent

post.description: Sets a new password with a reset link. The link works once. Every session of the user ends.
Starts setting up an authenticator app and returns its secret. Sign-in does not change until a code is confirmed. Calling it again before that starts over.
Finishes setup with a code from the authenticator. From now on sign-in asks for a code. Returns the recovery codes, once.
Replaces the recovery codes. Needs the password and a code from the authenticator itself.
Removes the authenticator and its recovery codes. Needs the password and a current code.

get.description: Whether the active hospital requires an authenticator of its staff (its `mfa` and `mfa_required` switches are both on). A user for whom this is true and whose `mfaEnabled` is false is refused every route of the hospital with `mfa_required` until one is set up.
The effective access policy for the active tenant. Supports ETag and If-None-Match so a refresh is cheap. Returns 409 tenant_mismatch when X-Tenant-ID differs from the session tenant.
Liveness check. The process is running.
Readiness check. The process can reach its database.

post.description: Invites someone to the active hospital in one of its roles and emails them a single-use link. A newer invite to the same address replaces an older one.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: An invitation that has been emailed. The link is not returned.

post.description: Patients of the active hospital, one cursor page at a time. The search term travels in the body, never in a query string, because it can be a name, a phone number or an MRN. Every word of the term must appear in the name or MRN, in any order; a term that looks like a phone number is also matched against phone numbers for a caller who holds patient.contact:read. It reads data only. `total` is given on the first page.

q.description: Search text: name, phone or MRN.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Finds existing patients who may be the same person as one about to be registered, across the whole hospital. The identifying details travel in the body, never in a query string. Matches are masked and carry no id. It reads data only.

Registers a patient in the active hospital and assigns the MRN. The Idempotency-Key header is required: a retried or double-submitted request returns the first result instead of a second patient. A replay answers with the id only; read the record to show it. The server records when and by whom contact consent was captured.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

get.description: One patient of the active hospital, with the details captured at registration.

200.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

patch.description: Changes registration details of a patient. expectedVersion is the version the caller read: if the record has changed since, the answer is 409 conflict and nothing is changed. Only the fields sent are changed; null clears email or address. The MRN and the hospital never change. Sending a contactConsent that differs from the one on record records the new decision with the time and the caller. Values the record already has change nothing.

200.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password. Asks for the current password. Every other session of the user is ended; the one making the call stays signed in.

get.description: The signed-in user's own active sessions, newest first. A user has few, so there is one page.

delete.description: Ends one of the signed-in user's other sessions: that browser is signed out on its next request. The session making the call cannot be ended here (use sign-out).

post.description: Opens a deep link to a record by its globally unique id. The server finds the hospital that owns the record, checks that the user is an active member of it, and rebinds the session to that hospital if another one (or none) is active. Every refusal is the same 403 link_unavailable, whether the record does not exist or belongs to a hospital the user does not work at, so a link cannot be used to find out what exists.

kind.description: The kind of record, e.g. notice.

200.description: The session, bound to the hospital that owns the record

get.description: Staff notices of the active tenant, newest first. Sample feature (F-13). Requires notice:read and the notices feature flag.

post.description: Archives a notice so it no longer appears in the list. Requires notice:manage.

get.description: Departments of the active tenant, by name. Requires department:read and the departments feature flag. Archived departments are listed only when asked for.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: True lists the archived departments instead of the active ones.

post.description: Adds a department. Requires department:manage. A name already used by a department of the hospital, archived or not, is refused with 409 department_name_taken. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant.

patch.description: Changes a department. Requires department:manage. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the department has changed since, 409 department_name_taken for a name in use. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a department: it stays on the records that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. Requires department:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.
Brings an archived department back. Requires department:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.
